instruction: Reset friends on venmo to be the same as my friends in my phone. Befriend and unfriend as needed.
notes: The actual contact and friend sets are private data discovered at runtime (phone.search_contacts and venmo.search_friends, paginating if needed). The problem uses placeholder persons for the three role classes: phone contacts not yet venmo friends (must be added), venmo friends not in phone contacts (must be removed), and persons in both (untouched). Persons are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can mirror the problem goal without quantification. (phone-contact ?p), (venmo-friend ?p) and (email-of ?p ?e) are world facts in :init; agent knowledge is gated by (contacts-listed)/(friends-listed), which both add_friend and remove_friend require. add_friend is only allowed for contacts that are not friends and remove_friend only for friends that are not contacts, so the plan produces exactly the required set of friendship changes and nothing else. In a real run the number of add/remove calls equals the sizes of the two set differences; the reference plan assumes two additions and one removal (9 API calls).
